name: weird
quote: What was that crazy loud sound?
description: Something perceived as out of the ordinary, neither harmful nor disgusting, but you're not sure it's something you want to experience often.

variations.name: attention-seeking weird
variations.description: A person or group you perceive as trying to be unusual in order to get attention for some reason.

variations.name: authentically weird
variations.description: A person or group you perceive as not trying to be unusual, but break normal patterns in some harmless way just by existing.

variations.name: silly weird
variations.description: A person or group you perceive as trying to be funny, but only succeeding in making themselves seem more immature.

variations.name: mentally weird
variations.description: A mental experience perceived as unusual, with hesitance to experience it again.

variations.name: existentially weird
variations.description: A deeply affecting experience that you don't necessarily regret, but wouldn't choose to have again.

variations.name: good weird
variations.description: Perception of something or someone unusual in a way you admire.

variations.name: bad weird
variations.description: Perception of something unusual that you would prefer to avoid if possible, but you won't run screaming.

commentaries.quote: People who have a taste for novelty probably like 'weird' more than those that have more constrained preferences.
Whether you try too hard to fit in or you try too hard to stand out, it is of equal consequence: you exhaust your significance.
There many inspiring quotes praising 'good weird'. Being a little unusual is kinda normal, but it's hard to tell how various social groups will judge your particular idiosyncracy over time.
We all want to be extraordinary and we all just want to fit in.

conditions: Something perceived as breaking a pattern that's neither harmful nor disgusting
Uncertainty about whether the experience was worth repeating.
